about_the_game:
Frost Survival VR Demo Highlights

🛠️Core sandbox survival experience
🔹base building,
🔹crafting basic tools,
🔹resource gathering,
🔹temperature system,
🔹sanity system
🗺️Explore limited sections of the huge map
👥Play solo or in coop
🔄Cross-platform - Steam and Meta Quest
⏳Time-limited demo: 4,2h, 7 days in-game

After a series of unfortunate events, you find yourself surrounded by an ice-covered wilderness. Isolated from the rest of the world, you must rely on your own wits and limited resources to survive these harsh conditions in this Sandbox Survival in VR.

Your main goal is to stay alive, but how?

Build your Base: Build a shelter to escape the frost and replenish vital strengths. Enjoy the freedom and construct it however you like. Warm up, protect from wild animals, wait out a snowstorm, store resources, and craft needed equipment there.

Tools & Weapons: To survive and fully exploit your surroundings, you will need a variety of tools. Every tool and item has its purpose and durability, which determines how long it can be used until it breaks.

Hunt, Craft & Gather: Hunt wild animals to gain food and resources. Collect items to craft tools, weapons, or clothing necessary for survival.

Surviving isn't easy. Strategizing your moves is crucial to staying alive. Complete essential tasks during daylight and be aware of the darkness, as nighttime brings lower temperatures. Weather conditions are unpredictable and change dynamically, so always be prepared!  Explore a huge map, but remember that not every place is safe; some may be inaccessible based on your current gear.

Survival isn’t just about staying alive, it’s also about staying sane. How do you keep your humanity in this frozen hell?
In Frost Survival VR, you must take care of not only your physiological needs, such as hunger, thirst, and keeping yourself warm, but also your mental health. If you neglect it, reality may start to blur with illusion. Fake sounds and creatures will make survival even more challenging. But beware - some figments of your imagination can harm you!

Try to survive alone or cooperate with others in a multiplayer experience.
Do you like playing alone? Don’t worry, there are some uncovered secrets scattered across the frozen wilderness that will help you endure. Or you can work together with other players: gather resources, insulate your shelter, and defend against threats like cold, hunger, and dangerous animals. Shape your survival sandbox experience your way!

The project is co-funded by the MEDIA strand of the European Union’s Creative Europe Programme.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600k
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR and SteamVR
  • Additional Notes: VR Headset required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR and SteamVR
  • Additional Notes: VR Headset required

short_description: Sandbox Survival in VR. Face a frozen wilderness solo or in co-op - build a shelter, craft tools, hunt for food, and manage your resources to endure harsh conditions. Strategize your moves against unpredictable weather and lurking dangers. And remember to keep yourself safe and sane!
